sentences.en: The old castle has a turret at each corner.
sentences.zh: 那座古老的城堡在每个角落都有一个塔楼。

sentences.en: From the top of the turret, you can see the entire city.
sentences.zh: 从塔楼上你可以看到整个城市。

sentences.en: The toy soldiers stood guard in the turret during our playtime.
sentences.zh: 在玩的时候，那些玩具士兵站在塔楼里守卫。

senses.zh: 炮塔；角楼；小塔；攻城用的冲车
防御塔（游戏《英雄联盟》中的防御建筑）
